title: Compute Mean Squared Error
description: Implement a vectorized calculation of Mean Squared Error to evaluate a regression model's predictions.
problemStatement: Write a Python function `calculate_mse(y_true: list[float], y_pred: list[float]) -> float` that computes the Mean Squared Error between true and predicted targets. Raise a `ValueError` if the lists have unequal lengths or are empty.
hints: Check that len(y_true) == len(y_pred) and len(y_true) > 0.
Divide by the number of elements N.
expectedOutput: Float representing the mean squared error (e.g. 0.25).
